**Subject:** Request for Receipt Copy – March 12, 2026  

Dear Boardwalk Restaurant Team,  

I hope this message finds you well. I recently dined at your restaurant on March 12, 2026, at approximately 1:58 PM, and I seem to have misplaced the receipt for my visit. The total amount charged was $515.56, and the payment was made using an American Express card (unfortunately, I do not have the last four digits of the card available).  

This was a business lunch for a client meeting, and I need a copy of the receipt or a written confirmation of the transaction for my company’s expense report submission. If possible, I would greatly appreciate receiving this by the end of the month to meet my reporting deadline.  

Please let me know if you need any additional details to locate the transaction. You can reach me via email at alex.chen@contoso.com or by phone at 555-0147.  

Thank you for your assistance, and I appreciate your time and help with this matter.  

Best regards,  
Alex Chen  
Account Manager  
Contoso Technologies  
alex.chen@contoso.com  
555-0147
